svg.title: High Level - Motivational Viewpoint — WHO Models

a.title: Control over data, easy access, secure sharing, trust (Value)
Interoperable patient records for continuity of care. (Value)
Reliable, verifiable data for claims and fraud prevention. (Value)
Trustworthy health data ecosystem and governance. (Value)
Aggregated, reliable data for planning and surveillance (Value)
Right to health and data ownership (Driver)
National/global push for interoperable DPI for Health (Driver)
Rising demand for secure, portable, and verifiable health data (Driver)
Verified patient records at point of care (Value)

Develop a secure and universally accessible system for issuing verifiable digital health records to individuals for their utilization as they seek care, following appropriate safeguards for privacy, security and consent (Goal)

text.tspan: Develop a secure and universally accessible system for issuing verifiable digital health records to individuals for their utilization as they
seek care, following appropriate safeguards for privacy, security and consent

a.title: Support interoperability across providers, facilities, and jurisdictions (Goal)
Ensure trust, security, and privacy in all transactions (Goal)
Enable patient control and consent-based sharing of health information (Goal)
Establish a secure, universally accessible, verifiable health record for every individual (Goal)

g.text: Colour: which part of the architecture a box belongs to
Why: who cares (stakeholders), and the drivers, goals, outcomes, values and requirements
Shape: what kind of thing a box is (its small italic label names the exact kind)
Cut corners: a reason or aim, such as a stakeholder, goal, outcome or value
Square corners: something that exists, such as a system, a role, or a piece of data
A box inside another box: a part of it
Grey band: a grouping for layout only; it adds no meaning
Line: how two boxes are related, read from where the line starts to where it ends
Composition: is made up of (the end is a part that cannot exist without the start)
Association: is related to (no more specific meaning)
